criticals: C1 (DB1): HubController never passed styles_service/snippets_service into HubState — the Styles/Snippets views were permanently 'unavailable' in production while the write buttons worked (both suites green because make_hub omitted the keys). Fixed: the services are wired through initWithSpec_; the shared make_hub now carries them and a new hub_shell test builds both views headless with a full add/toggle/delete cycle.

C2 (DB1, corroborated by CA1 as W1): the M06 finalize scope upgrade rebuilt the job's normalization policy from dictionary skills alone, silently dropping the frozen manifest skills on every site/workspace-resolving destination (ai_prompt exactly) while the envelope still claimed the registry — AC03 break with contradictory provenance. Fixed: _finalized_policy is the single owner of the upgraded policy's skill set (one SkillRegistry merging manifest + widened-scope dictionary skills, under the style-derived profile); regression test drives a scope-upgraded job with a manifest skill.
warnings_addressed: spaced {{ name }} placeholders declared by the regex but never substituted by expand (AC02 silent wrong expansion) — expand now substitutes both forms via per-name patterns

stale_workspace was structurally always False (the predicate read freeze-time global-only records) — tracked against the last FINALIZED registry's workspace-scoped records; regression test switches workspaces across two jobs

finalize-only rules (site/category) changed the envelope but never the job's normalization (number policy) — _m10_re_resolve runs inside the finalize before the scope upgrade and _m10_finalize_upgrade rebuilds the policy on profile drift; regression test with a site-scoped standard-numbers rule

profile-scoped vocabulary was live only for app/global rules (the freeze-time Destination had no category; the widened scope carried no profile) — the freeze derives the writing category from the PTT identity and the widened scope carries the resolved profile name; regression test approves the seeded Claude Code entry and rewrites in the IDE destination

file-tag resolution was O(k²·m) with per-step Path construction and an unbounded reference run — precomputed lowered full-path/basename maps (resolve p95 3.1→0.01 ms) and a 12-word reference cap; regression test with a long ramble
